headline: Executive order aimed at changing how the federal government manages its top career leaders, the Senior Executive Service.
what_it_does: This order is about the Senior Executive Service, the group of senior career managers who run major programs in federal agencies. Based on its title, it directs changes meant to strengthen this group. No summary was provided, so the specific rules it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Senior Executive Service
who_it_affects.how: The order concerns the rules and practices that apply to these senior federal managers.
Agencies that employ senior executives may need to follow any new direction the order sets for managing them.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 15, 2015; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
